==Bundles==
Hematite is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
Hematite is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Hematite is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Vintage Polo]].  [[File:Shirt198.png|24px]] It is a copper dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the orange dye pot at Emily's and Haley's house for use in dyeing.
